subject: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Jordan —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:  

- Goal: POC using Redwood Hosted API for AtlasAI's suggestion-generation pipeline (low-latency inference + embeddings for rerank).
- POC timeline: 1-2 weeks to validate latency and quality.
- What we'll provide today: a Hosted API quickstart (API key, sample curl/snippet), sample endpoints for generation + embeddings, and a summary of default rate limits + how to request evaluation higher limits.

Quickstart checklist (attached):
1) Create org + API key (we can seed a trial key for you).
2) Use the hosted generation endpoint (POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate). Example curl in the PDF.
3) For embeddings: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings.
4) Default limits: we typically ship evaluation accounts with conservative default request limits; if you need higher RPS for the POC we can temporarily raise them — details below.

A few questions to help us prep:
- Expected QPS and avg tokens per request for the POC?
- Are you evaluating streaming responses / function calling for final UX?
- Any data residency constraints for the trial?

I've attached the quickstart and a short rate-limits summary. If you're good, I can seed a trial API key and Marissa (cc'd) can spin up a short-lived quota bump for your tests.

Available tomorrow for a 30-min walkthrough if helpful.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood_hosted_quickstart.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: redwood_rate_limits_summary.pdf (PDF)]
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@atlasai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasAI Engineering <eng@atlasai.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 20:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side before the POC:  

- For the POC we expect ~10-20 RPS and ~150-400 tokens per generation call. Embeddings volume will be lower (~30-35 requests total) but high QPS could matter if we batch.
- We plan to try streaming for the UX, then fall back to non-streaming if there are issues.
- Data residency: for the POC we can use US-hosted endpoints; long term we may need EU options depending on customers.

Two specific questions:
1) What are the exact default rate limits (requests/min or requests/sec) per API key?
2) If we need a temporary bump for the POC, what's the process and typical turnaround?

Happy to take the walkthrough — can do Friday morning PST.

Jordan
Jordan Hayes
Head of Product | AtlasAI
jordan.hayes@atlasai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@atlasai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Thanks Jordan — quick answers below. I'm on hand to help with the trial config and can coordinate any temporary quota increases.

Rate limits (hosted API) — default evaluation profile:
- Generation endpoint: 60 requests/min (burstable). If you use streaming, per-connection limits apply; streaming sessions are optimized for low latency.
- Embeddings endpoint: 300 requests/min (higher concurrency to support batched encode jobs).
- We also enforce token-level throttles for very high token workloads; we'll monitor during the POC and can adjust.

Temporary bumps: we can grant a short-lived quota increase for the POC (typical turnaround: same day if requested before 3pm PT). For your stated 10-20 RPS we'll likely provision a higher evaluation bucket — I'll map this to a concrete limit once we know expected sustained RPS and token counts.

Endpoints & quickstart notes:
- Generation: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate — supports streaming (chunked) and function/tool-calling. Sample curl in the quickstart PDF attached.
- Embeddings: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings — supports batching via the same endpoint; see examples in the doc.
- Auth: API keys via Authorization: Bearer <KEY>.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aditya seeds a trial API key for AtlasAI (we can pre-configure an evaluation quota).
2) Jordan/Eng confirm a small test dataset and desired sustained RPS window.
3) Marissa provisions a temporary quota bump and schedules a short sync to watch first runs.

If Friday morning PST works, I'll join the call and we can walk through telemetry you'll see in the Console (latency by route, token breakdown).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@atlasai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits

Thanks both — that all sounds good. Friday 10:00am PST works for us. Please go ahead and seed a trial API key and bump the quota to support ~15 RPS sustained with bursts to 25 RPS for the first 48 hours. We'll send a small sample dataset (100 prompts + 30 embedding inputs) before the call.

Jordan
Jordan Hayes
Head of Product | AtlasAI
jordan.hayes@atlasai.com
